$comment: Ava's tour: one line per section, in her own words. `text` is shown (caption and transcript); `say`, when present, is what the voice reads instead (spelled-out letters, a pause). scripts/narrate.mjs renders each line to public/audio/ with the app's local Kokoro voice. Never name the product here, so a rename needs no new audio.

lines.label: Hello
lines.text: Hi, I'm Ava. I work in your browser's side panel, on the pages you already use. Scroll, and I'll show you around.

lines.label: The gate
lines.text: Here's my one rule. I can read, click and type for you, but before anything is sent, posted, bought or deleted, I stop and wait for your click.

lines.label: Every step
lines.text: Every step I take is drawn as a trail, so you always know where I am. If a page needs your sign-in, I hand it to you, and you can stop me at any step.

lines.label: Voice
lines.text: You can talk to me, too. Just say “Hey Ava”: the wake word is heard on your computer. Or dictate, and edit the words before you send.
lines.say: You can talk to me, too. Just say, hey Ava. The wake word is heard on your computer. Or dictate, and edit the words before you send.

lines.label: Memory
lines.text: I take notes in your calls, and I remember the pages you saved. Ask me what was decided, and I'll show you exactly where it came from.

lines.label: Routines and agents
lines.text: Describe a routine in one sentence, and I'll draw it and run it on schedule. Anything that would post waits in your Inbox, for you.
lines.say: Describe a routine in one sentence, and I'll draw it and run it on schedule. Anything that would post waits in your inbox, for you.

lines.label: Models
lines.text: Choose the model that thinks for me: one on your own computer, or a cloud model with your own key. No subscription, and no account.

lines.label: Integrations
lines.text: I work with the tools you already use, like Gmail, Drive, Slack, GitHub and Notion, or any MCP server. If a tool would change something, I ask first.
lines.say: I work with the tools you already use, like Gmail, Drive, Slack, GitHub and Notion, or any M C P server. If a tool would change something, I ask first.

lines.label: Privacy
lines.text: And there's no server of ours to find. Your chats, notes and keys stay in your browser, and the rest goes only where you send it.

lines.label: Install
lines.text: That's the tour. One command installs me, and one click turns me on. I'll be in your side panel, waiting for your click.
